rows.note: This is the standard noun for a software application; in casual speech, speakers also commonly say “app”.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1 gei2 hou2 jung6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a request for a job, place, service, or course.

example.english: I want to submit an application for that part-time job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 go2 go3 gim1 zik1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the application is a form that must be filled in or submitted.

example.english: Have you filled in the application form yet?
example.jyutping: nei5 tin4 hou2 san1 cing2 biu2 mei6 aa3
